summary: A browse-and-scan screen for the whole Egyptian Exchange: search, index-universe filter chips, an A–Z company list with delayed prices, sector weight cards, latest regulatory disclosures, and an earnings calendar. It is purely navigational/informational — the only wired action is tapping a company row to open the Company screen.

sections.name: Phone shell + status bar (shared chrome, not part of the screen body)
sections.description: The screen renders inside a fixed 390x844 device frame. A non-interactive status bar overlays the top, and the whole screen body lives in one vertically scrolling container whose padding defines the page gutters. Content width available to the screen = 390 - 16 - 16 = 358px.
sections.layout: Shell: width:390px; height:844px; border-radius:46px; overflow:hidden; background:linear-gradient(180deg,#EDE8E2 0%,#E3DCD4 100%); box-shadow:0 30px 70px rgba(27,25,23,.20), 0 0 0 1px rgba(27,25,23,.07). Status bar: position:absolute; top:0; left:0; right:0; height:54px; z-index:6; display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:space-between; padding:0 26px; pointer-events:none; font:500 13px/1 'IBM Plex Sans Arabic',sans-serif; color:#1B1917; font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums. Right cluster: display:flex; align-items:center; gap:5px; three bars all background:#1B1917 — 16x9 border-radius:2px opacity:.85, then 5x9 border-radius:1px opacity:.5, then 22x10 border-radius:3px opacity:.85. Scroll container: position:absolute; inset:0; overflow-y:auto; scrollbar-width:none; padding:54px 16px 124px; box-sizing:border-box.

sections.name: Screen root column
sections.description: Single vertical stack holding all six content blocks, with one uniform gap. Enters with a rise-and-fade animation.
sections.layout: display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:24px; animation:bRise 240ms ease-out. Keyframe bRise = from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(4px)} to{opacity:1;transform:translateY(0)}.

sections.name: Header — title + search field
sections.description: Page title "Market" with a pill-shaped search affordance underneath. The search field is display-only in the design: it has NO onClick handler and no input element — it is a tappable-looking placeholder row.
sections.layout: Wrapper: padding-top:6px. Title: font:300 36px/1 Outfit,sans-serif; letter-spacing:-0.03em; color:#1B1917. Search pill: margin-top:16px; display:flex; align-items:center; gap:10px; background:#F7F4F0; border-radius:999px; padding:14px 18px; box-shadow:0 8px 24px rgba(27,25,23,.08); color:#7A736D (this is the icon's currentColor). Icon: inline <svg width=17 height=17 viewBox="0 0 17 17" style="flex:none"> containing <circle cx=7.2 cy=7.2 r=5 fill=none stroke=currentColor stroke-width=1.5> and <rect x=10.6 y=11.3 width=5.4 height=1.5 rx=.75 transform="rotate(45 10.6 11.3)" fill=currentColor>. Placeholder text: font:400 14px/1 'IBM Plex Sans Arabic',sans-serif; color:#9A938C.

sections.name: Index universe chip row
sections.description: Horizontally scrolling row of four filter chips selecting the listing universe. EGX30 is the selected state. No onClick handlers are wired in the design — selection is static/hard-coded, so tapping does nothing yet. The row bleeds full-width past the 16px page gutter via negative margins.
sections.layout: Row: display:flex; gap:8px; overflow-x:auto; scrollbar-width:none; margin:0 -16px; padding:0 16px. Selected chip: flex:none; padding:11px 18px; border-radius:999px; background:#1B1917; font:400 13px/1 'IBM Plex Sans Arabic',sans-serif; color:#F5F1EC. Unselected chip: flex:none; padding:11px 18px; border-radius:999px; background:rgba(27,25,23,.06); font:400 13px/1 'IBM Plex Sans Arabic',sans-serif; color:#5C554F. No transition or active-press style on chips.

sections.name: Companies · A–Z list
sections.description: Eyebrow header with a right-aligned total count, then a vertical list of company rows (ticker monogram, English name, Arabic name, price, change), closed by a staleness disclaimer. Seed data supplies 7 rows even though the template hint is 6.
sections.layout: Header row: display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:space-between; margin-bottom:12px. Eyebrow: font:400 11px/1 'IBM Plex Sans Arabic',sans-serif; letter-spacing:.16em; text-transform:uppercase; color:#7A736D. Count: font:400 12px/1 'IBM Plex Sans Arabic',sans-serif; color:#9A938C; font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums. List: display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:8px. ROW (onClick = p.goCompany): display:flex; align-items:center; gap:14px; background:#F7F4F0; border-radius:24px; padding:12px 16px; box-shadow:0 8px 24px rgba(27,25,23,.06); cursor:pointer; transition:transform 220ms ease-out; active state transform:scale(0.99). Monogram: width:48px; height:48px; flex:none; border-radius:16px; background:#1B1917; display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; font:400 12px/1 Outfit,sans-serif; letter-spacing:.06em; color:#F5F1EC. Middle column: flex:1; min-width:0 — English name font:400 15px/1.2 Outfit,sans-serif; color:#1B1917; Arabic name margin-top:3px; font:300 11px/1.3 'IBM Plex Sans Arabic',sans-serif; color:#7A736D; dir="rtl". Right column: text-align:right — price font:400 15px/1 Outfit,sans-serif; color:#1B1917; font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums. Grid: display:grid; grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr; gap:12px (each card is therefore (358-12)/2 = 173px wide inside the 390px shell). interactions: Screen entry: the whole root column animates `bRise` 240ms ease-out — opacity 0→1 with transform translateY(4px)→translateY(0). In Flutter: FadeTransition + SlideTransition (4px upward), 240ms, Curves.easeOut.

Company row tap: onClick = p.goCompany → routes to the Company (SWDY) screen. Critically, goCompany is called WITHOUT a nav argument (`g('company')`), so the bottom nav's active tab STAYS on Market. Do not switch the nav selection when pushing Company from here.
Company row press feedback: transform:scale(0.99) while active, transition:transform 220ms ease-out. In Flutter: AnimatedScale 0.99 / 220ms / Curves.easeOut on pointer-down, back to 1.0 on release.

Sector card press feedback: transform:scale(0.98), transition:transform 220ms ease-out. There is NO onClick — the card is pressable-looking but inert in the design. Flag this to product before wiring a destination.
Search pill: no handler, no <input>. It is a static row. If wired later, it should push a search route; the design gives no focused/typing state, so that state is UNSPECIFIED.

Filter chips (EGX30 / EGX70 / EGX100 / All listed): no onClick, no transition, no active style. Selection is hard-coded to EGX30. The selected/unselected token pair is defined, but the state machine is UNSPECIFIED in this file.
Chip row: horizontally scrollable, scrollbars hidden (`scrollbar-width:none`, and a global `*::-webkit-scrollbar{width:0;height:0;display:none}`). No snapping specified.
Page scroll: single vertical scroll view, scrollbar hidden, no pull-to-refresh, no sticky header, no parallax specified.
Disclosure rows and earnings rows: no handlers, no press states — read-only.

Bottom nav: tapping Market calls g('market','market'). The selection pill animates with `bPill` 320ms cubic-bezier(.32,1.2,.44,1) (opacity 0→1, transform-origin center) — an overshoot curve; in Flutter approximate with Cubic(0.32, 1.2, 0.44, 1.0).
No loading, empty, or error variant of the Market screen exists in this file — the STATES screen (lines 696-751) holds those and was not read for this spec.
No haptics, sounds, or scroll-linked effects are specified anywhere in this screen.
flutterNotes:
STRUCTURE
- Build the frame as a fixed 390x844 container only for design comparison; in production use SafeArea + a Stack: [scrolling body, bottom scrim, floating nav].
- Body = SingleChildScrollView(padding: EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(16, 54, 16, 124)) wrapping a Column(crossAxisAlignment: stretch) with 24px SizedBox gaps (or Column + spacing: 24 on Flutter 3.27+). Content width is 358px on a 390pt device.
- The chip row must escape the 16px gutter: wrap it in an OverflowBox / negative-margin Transform, or restructure so the scroll view has 0 horizontal padding and each non-chip section gets its own EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 16). The second approach is cleaner and matches `margin:0 -16px; padding:0 16px` exactly — the chip ListView gets padding: EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 16) and scrollDirection: Axis.horizontal.
- Hide scrollbars: ScrollConfiguration with a behavior returning the child unmodified from buildScrollbar.

TYPOGRAPHY MAPPING (CSS `font: weight size/lh family`)
- `/1` → height: 1.0; `/1.2` → height: 1.2; `/1.3` → 1.3; `/1.45` → 1.45; `/1.4` → 1.4. Flutter's `height` is exactly the CSS unitless line-height, so these transfer 1:1, but note Flutter centers the leading differently — set `leadingDistribution: TextLeadingDistribution.even` on the TextStyle (or textHeightBehavior) so the 36px/1 title and the 30px/1 sector numerals do not sit lower than the HTML.
- Weight map: 200→FontWeight.w200, 300→w300, 400→w400, 500→w500. Outfit needs 200/300/400/500; IBM Plex Sans Arabic needs 300/400/500. Bundle both as assets — no network fonts.
- letter-spacing is in `em` in the CSS but Flutter's letterSpacing is LOGICAL PIXELS. Precomputed: .16em @11px = 1.76; .06em @12px = 0.72; .06em @11px = 0.66; .1em @9px = 0.90; -0.03em @36px = -1.08; -0.03em @13px (status bar has none) n/a; -0.02em @30px = -0.60.
- `text-transform:uppercase` is CSS-only — the source strings are "Companies · A–Z", "Sectors", "Latest disclosures", "Earnings calendar", "Aug". Uppercase them in the widget (`.toUpperCase()`), NOT in the data, so Arabic localisation is unaffected (Arabic has no case; `toUpperCase()` is a no-op there, which is correct).
- `font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums` → fontFeatures: [FontFeature.tabularFigures()]. Apply to: price, count 243, change delta, sector numeral + weight, disclosure age, earnings day, status-bar clock. Confirm the bundled Outfit/IBM Plex Sans Arabic actually ship the `tnum` feature; if not, fall back to a fixed-width numeral or SizedBox-aligned columns, otherwise the right-aligned price column will jitter.

SHADOWS
- `0 8px 24px rgba(27,25,23,.06)` → BoxShadow(offset: Offset(0,8), blurRadius: 24, color: Color(0x0F1B1917)) — CSS blur radius maps ~1:1 to Flutter blurRadius here (no spread anywhere on this screen), so no /2 conversion is needed. Alphas: .06→0x0F, .08→0x14.
- The disclosure divider is `box-shadow: inset 0 -1px 0 rgba(27,25,23,.08)` — an inset shadow, which Flutter's BoxShadow cannot do. Implement as a 1px bottom Border (Color(0x141B1917)) on each row's BoxDecoration. Note it is drawn on EVERY row including the LAST one, so do not use a `separatorBuilder` — put the border on the row itself.

CARDS
- Every card is Container(decoration: BoxDecoration(color: Color(0xFFF7F4F0), borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(24), boxShadow: [cardShadow])). Radius 24 with 48px children means no clipping concerns; skip ClipRRect (it forces a saveLayer).
- The sector grid is a 2-column layout with 12px gaps and unequal intrinsic heights. `grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr` with default `align-items:stretch` means BOTH cards in a row are as tall as the taller one. GridView with childAspectRatio will NOT reproduce that faithfully if text wraps ("Telecom & IT" may wrap at 173px width). Use Row(crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch) with two Expanded children per row, inside an IntrinsicHeight — or a Wrap with fixed-width children only if you accept ragged heights. Prefer the Row/IntrinsicHeight approach.

PRESS FEEDBACK
- Company row scale(0.99) and sector card scale(0.98) over 220ms ease-out. Use a small StatefulWidget with GestureDetector(onTapDown/onTapUp/onTapCancel) driving an AnimatedScale(duration: 220ms, curve: Curves.easeOut). Do NOT use InkWell — there is no ripple anywhere in this design system, and the paper surface would show it.
- The earnings row has NO press feedback and no handler; do not accidentally reuse the company-row widget with a tap target.

TRICKY BITS
- The bottom nav's `backdrop-filter: blur(26px) saturate(180%)` needs BackdropFilter(filter: ImageFilter.blur(sigmaX: ~13, sigmaY: ~13)) inside a ClipRRect(999). CSS blur radius ≈ 2x Gaussian sigma, so 26px → sigma ≈ 13. `saturate(180%)` has no Flutter equivalent in ImageFilter; approximate with a ColorFilter.matrix saturation matrix composed via ImageFilter.compose, or drop it and accept a slightly flatter glass. Because it is expensive, keep the BackdropFilter inside a RepaintBoundary and do not put one behind the scrolling content.
- The nav selection pill is `width: calc((100% - 12px)/4)` positioned at left:6 with `translateX(100%)` for Market — i.e. it self-offsets by its own width, not by a percentage of the bar. Compute pillWidth = (barWidth - 12)/4 and set left = 6 + pillWidth * index. Do not use FractionalTranslation on the bar width.
- The 118px bottom scrim gradient uses three near-identical warm greys with rising alpha — reproduce the exact stops (0%, 52%, 100%) or the fade will band.
- The search icon is a hand-built SVG, not an icon-font glyph. Draw it with CustomPainter or inline flutter_svg: circle centre (7.2,7.2) r=5 stroke 1.5, plus a 5.4x1.5 rounded bar (rx .75) rotated 45deg about its own (10.6,11.3) origin, in a 17x17 box. Colour comes from the parent (#7A736D), not from the text colour (#9A938C).
- The bottom-nav Market icon is three rounded bars in a 20x20 viewBox scaled to 21x21 — also CustomPainter/SVG, not Icons.bar_chart.

PRODUCT RULES
- Nothing on this screen expresses BUY / SELL / TARGET PRICE / STOP LOSS / EXPECTED RETURN, and nothing should be added. The only judgement-adjacent element is the ▲/▼ percent change, which is a factual price move — keep it that way.
- Direction is never colour-only: ▲/▼ glyphs carry it. If you replace the glyphs with Icons, keep a semantic label ("up 2.11 percent") for screen readers, and never render the delta as a bare coloured number.
- "Prices delayed 15 minutes" is a hard requirement under the list — it is the staleness label for every price on the screen. It must render even when the list is empty or loading, and the "15 minutes" should be driven by the real feed's delay rather than hard-coded once the data layer exists. The disclosure ages ("2h", "5h", "1d") are also staleness labels and must not be dropped for space.
- Semantics: give each company row a merged Semantics node ("Commercial International Bank, COMI, 78.30 Egyptian pounds, down 0.63 percent") and a button role; the 48px monogram alone would otherwise be announced as a bare ticker string.

RTL / ARABIC (direction-sensitive items)
- Company rows already mix scripts: the English name is LTR and the Arabic name is explicitly `dir="rtl"`. In Flutter, wrap the Arabic Text in Directionality(textDirection: TextDirection.rtl) — or set textDirection on the Text — regardless of app locale, or Egyptian names will render with mangled punctuation ordering.
- `text-align:right` on the price column must become TextAlign.end (mirrors to left in Arabic). Do NOT hard-code TextAlign.right.
- Row order (monogram → names → price) mirrors automatically if you use Row with start/end semantics and EdgeInsetsDirectional. Replace all EdgeInsets.only(left/right) with EdgeInsetsDirectional.
- The disclosure row's fixed 46px ticker column is on the LEADING side — use a SizedBox inside a Row so it flips to the right in Arabic.
- The chip row's `margin:0 -16px; padding:0 16px` must mirror; use EdgeInsetsDirectional.symmetric(horizontal: 16) and the ListView will honour Directionality for scroll start.
- The ▲/▼ glyphs are direction-neutral and need no mirroring. The search magnifier conventionally mirrors in RTL — decide deliberately; the design does not specify.
- Text growth risk: Arabic sector names and disclosure headlines run longer than the English. The disclosure headline is `flex:1; min-width:0` (i.e. it wraps freely), but the sector card name at 13px/1.3 in a 173px card and the earnings detail at 11px in a flexible column have no maxLines specified — the design gives no truncation rule, so decide one (I'd suggest maxLines: 2 + TextOverflow.ellipsis for card names) and note it as an addition, not something read from the file.

VALUES I DID NOT SEE AND AM NOT GUESSING
- No maxLines / overflow / ellipsis rules for any text on this screen.
- No focus, hover, disabled, selected-chip-change, or error states.
- No loading / empty / error variant of Market (those live on the STATES screen, not read here).
- No scroll physics, refresh control, or pagination behaviour for the 243-company list — only 7 rows exist in the seed data (the `hint-placeholder-count` is 6, but the array has 7 entries; render all 7).
- No dark-mode variant: this file is a light canvas, despite the header calling the app "dark-first". Ask before inventing dark tokens.
- No spacing between the last earnings card and the end of scroll other than the container's 124px bottom padding.
